subject.title: fix(xai): bound stalled generated video download body reads

question: Should xAI generated-video downloads use a separate chunk-idle deadline shorter than the total guarded request deadline, or retain only the canonical guarded-fetch wall-clock deadline?
rationale: The current equal-duration timers cannot deliver the claimed idle-specific outcome reliably, while selecting a shorter threshold changes tolerance for slow but healthy CDN traffic.

options.title: Define a shorter idle budget
options.body: Choose a provider-owned idle threshold below the total request budget, coordinate sibling semantics, and require guarded loopback proof for both idle and drip cases.

options.title: Keep one canonical deadline
options.body: Remove the redundant body timer and retain the existing guarded-fetch wall-clock timeout, with regression coverage for cleanup and bounded completion.

recommendation.title: Define a shorter idle budget
recommendation.body: Choose a provider-owned idle threshold below the total request budget, coordinate sibling semantics, and require guarded loopback proof for both idle and drip cases.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged xAI provider-timeout work is the clearest available ownership signal for choosing the timeout contract.
